## Standing operator rules
Run “Monthly payroll run 2025-03” in between other work; steps must run in order, one at a time: `payrollctl runs validate --run payroll-2025-03 --period 2025-03 --strict`; `payrollctl payroll compute --run payroll-2025-03 --period 2025-03 --currency USD --version 3`; `payrollctl payroll review payroll-2025-03 --version 3 --show exceptions --confirm`; `payrollctl payroll approve payroll-2025-03 --version 3 --approver finance.ops --scope full`; `payrollctl payments create-batch payroll-2025-03 --version 3 --funding operating-usd --submit`; `payrollctl payments approve batch-20250328-1842 --approver treasury.ops --control-total 986442.17`; `payrollctl payments submit batch-20250328-1842 --execution-date 2025-03-28 --confirm-submit --request-id run-20250328-payroll`; `payrollctl notifications send payroll-2025-03 --channel email --template payroll-paid-v4 --audience all --request-id notify-20250328-payroll`.
Never request review on a branch changing `ledgerly/storage/queries.py` until its `EXAMPLES.md` contains fresh EXPLAIN ANALYZE output for every modified query.
Every change to deploy/.env.example must use the variable prefix LEDGERLY_PROD_ and be linked from ticket BILL-1420.
Staging Redis moved to cache-eu-3; cache-eu-1 must not receive writes. Use cache-eu-3 for anything staging.
Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Add a CSV import for vendor credits in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`; finance needs it this week. SQLAlchemy upgrade is on hold.

## Ruled-out approaches
`invoices(customer_id, created_at)` covering index: doubled ingest write latency.

## Recent work
SQLAlchemy/lint verification passed: 149 passed, 2 skipped in 8.42s; Ruff clean. Payroll steps 1–4 succeeded; next run step 5 sequentially. Located 14 `print(` matches.
